newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ New Zealand Dec qtr profit falls.
newsitem.headline: ANZ New Zealand Dec qtr profit falls.

text.p: ANZ Banking Group (New Zealand) Ltd on Thursday reported a NZ$30.1 million net profit for the December quarter, down from $36.9 million a year earlier.

Acting Managing Director Andrew Ward said the decline was anticipated. It stemmed from project costs being incurred earlier than in the previous financial year, and restructuring costs associated with branch closures.

Ward said the group last September modified its capital structure by paying a dividend, replacing this with subordinated debt. The interest cost from the latter resulted in lower net interest income compared with the previous year.

The December quarter profit represented a return on shareholder equity of 17.5 percent, up from 15.3 percent a year ago. Total assets rose $3.1 billion from December 1995 to reach NZ$21.4 billion, while the capital adequacy ratio at December 31, 1996, was 10.1 percent. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
